ctx.x: Yeah, the local 208 -- those men I mentioned were quite influential in union affairs also.

Yeah, he didn't let me go in there and when I got with Louie, he came out -- came down there to pull me off, I think, either he or Art Stewart, one of the two -- I don't know which one, came down there to pull me off the job there, but --
